name: spaces_get_nodes
description: Read-only. Full values + connections of `nodeIds`, or nodes found by `query` on every page with `matches`. `query` matches by meaning, so another language or a typo still finds the node. Needs view perm.

nodeIds.description: Exactly one of nodeIds or query.

query.description: What the node is or does, any language. An exact node name ranks first.
